guard/30584.htm.text: Centurion Vapook: Behold, the domicile of Lord, Kakai ! You'll find the Lords gathered on the second floor of King's Hall. You must always remember to give them proper deference!

links.text: "Who is the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/30584-1.htm.text: Centurion Vapook: Kakai, the Flame Lord, is a great Orc. It was amazing to see him duel with Raoul, the King of Men a long time ago. They were well-matched in combat.
